base.$description: Base padding between the viewport edge and page content.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint padding between the viewport edge and page content.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint padding between the viewport edge and page content.

text.$description: Maximum width for readable prose, section descriptions, documentation notes and long-form text blocks. Use to prevent text from stretching across wide layouts. At a default 16px root size, 38rem equals 608px.

narrow.$description: Maximum width for narrow layout containers such as forms, dialogs or focused content areas.

default.$description: Default maximum width for standard page containers.

wide.$description: Wide maximum width for complex layouts, dashboards or multi-column content.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint spacing between grid columns.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint spacing between grid columns.
